summary: Whether you show it or not, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you build things that last and carry real weight and you think for yourself and break the mold. At the edge, you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
body: Whether you show it or not, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you build things that last and carry real weight and you think for yourself and break the mold. At the edge, you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you think for yourself and break the mold.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes - or you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control.
integration: Let discipline and limits and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you think for yourself work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
